chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Hamdan ibn Suleyman, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Al-Walid, raising it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who intends to increase his wealth, let him prolong the standing upon As-Safa and Al-Marwa.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: As-Safa, one of the two hills between which pilgrims walk
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: Al-Marwa, the second hill in the Sa'i ritual

ai.seo_question: How can I increase my wealth according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) states that prolonging the ritual standing (wuquf) between Safa and Marwa during Hajj or Umrah is a means to increase one's wealth. This hadith links a specific ritual action in worship with economic prosperity, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that the spiritual merit of remembering Allah in the places of His remembrance brings barakah (blessing) into one's worldly affairs. The emphasis on 'prolonging' suggests that mindful contemplation and supplication during this pause are key to unlocking this divine provision.
